{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where flipper_length_mm is missing
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species

# Print the full result to ensure evidence is grounded
mean_flipper_by_species"}
